guidelines.detail: refines XML-06 (The validator reports a sequenceFlow where activity properties are expected, supporting a sequence flow nested in an invalid location. The description gives activities in process order. XML-06 already prohibits nesting sequenceFlow inside tasks, gateways, or events; this guideline clarifies the valid scope placement more generally.)

refines GW-01 (The description identifies alternative order channels, and the cited reference flows show an exclusive gateway before shared confirmation handling. This refines the general guidance to use gateways for divergence by specifying how to model alternative initiation routes. No extra_element records were provided, so the evidence supports the missing-flow pattern but cannot establish that the generated)

refines FID-03 (The label pairs show omitted or substituted details, while the description supports preserving them. This refines the documented rule to use faithful labels by specifying which explicit details to retain; it is also more specific than the closest learned guideline.)
same as LRN-012 (The description names alternative initiation channels, and the missing start-to-gateway flow supports modeling that routing. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-012.)

same as LRN-013 (The description supports the reference’s order-placement, handover, and generate-and-send details, while the generated labels substitute or omit details (P1, P3, P4). This is already essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-013. P2 is not cited because the generated label includes a detail stated in the description.)

same as LRN-012 (The description names two ways to place an order, while the recorded missing flows show the alternative-channel branch was not represented. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-012.)

same as LRN-013 (The label mismatches show omissions or substitutions, while the description clarifies the intended actions and details. This guideline is essentially the same as learned guideline LRN-013.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents activities whose execution order must be represented in BPMN: Represent that order with sequence flows that are direct children of the relevant process or subprocess scope; do not place sequence flows inside activities or other BPMN elements.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents activities whose execution order must be represented in BPMN

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents alternative ways to initiate a process that lead to the same subsequent handling: Represent the alternatives with an exclusive gateway and converge them before the shared handling; do not invent channel-specific work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents alternative ways to initiate a process that lead to the same subsequent handling

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions: Preserve those stated details in the BPMN task label rather than omitting or substituting them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions
